kinds.d: A loose stuffed decorative cushion for a sofa, chair or bed.
A plain stuffed inner made to fill a cushion cover.
A thin cushion, usually with ties or a non-slip back, made to lie on the seat of a chair.
A large frameless cushion made to sit on at floor level.
A firm frameless cushion, round or crescent, made to sit on for meditation.
A flat padded mat laid on the floor under a meditation cushion or to sit on.

notes: Six old kinds kept with old sources; meditation cushion and mat placed together. Floor-cushion forms recorded as types. Kept the four old Monastery Store models (paired cushion/mat lines, not a SKU dump).
